verdict.rationale: The evidence shows online filing services and a Premier Business Services (PBS) account with setup videos. None of it describes the sign-in method: no credential-based MFA, no remote verification step, and no statement ruling out biometric, in-person or mailed-PIN identity checks. Having an account and online services is adjacent to this story, not evidence of the required sign-in path, so the verdict stays at none.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
